_source: full_amount, threshold and max_reduction are the ACCESS BH initial-period parameters (references/risk-share-models.md, Anchor 2: $180 allowed amount, of which the Medicare portion is 80 percent, $144; the factor applies to the $144, of which $72 is withheld; 50 percent outcome attainment threshold, 50 percent cap). The two fixed-plus-outcome designs use the same $144 base so the three rows compare like with like. outcome_share 0.2 is the German statutory floor (Anchor 1). The de20 threshold is an illustrative input, not a sourced rule: the German framework method is not set.
basis: ACCESS BH initial Medicare portion (80 percent of the $180 allowed amount); $72 of it is withheld
